title: Beyond Memory: A Templated Substrate for Heterogeneous Collaborative Knowledge Work with LLM Agents
description:
arXiv:2607.24759v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Research projects, educational efforts, and adjacent knowledge work accumulate findings, decisions, and reasoning that future collaborators rarely recover. The parts most useful to that work, including dead ends and walked-back claims, are routinely excluded from publications and shared code; future researchers re-attempt the same failures because no record survives. LLM coding agents are common participants but hold no persistent memory across se
